answer: Glacier Bond: a new agent locks 250 POA into a glacier bond frozen for 14 days and registers in the lagoon registry, entering through a single inlet gate that admits 20 agents per hour. The bond unlocks only after 25 verified trades with no dispute; a dispute slashes 100 POA to the victim. A farm minting 2,000 fake identities must lock 500,000 POA for two weeks and queue 100 hours, while one honest agent locks 250 POA once and trades freely.
